title: SCDOT Work-Zone Law Enforcement Scheduling, Roster Correspondence, and Canceled Detail Records (Greenville, Laurens, and Newberry Counties)

communications.subject: South Carolina Public Records Law Request: SCDOT Work-Zone Law Enforcement Scheduling, Roster Correspondence, and Canceled Detail Records (Greenville, Laurens, and Newberry Counties)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the South Carolina Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

I request copies of the following public records for Greenville County, Laurens County, and Newberry County from January 1, 2025, to the present:
  
​1. SCDPS / SCDOT Correspondence: All written correspondence (including emails, letters, and memoranda) between SCDOT Engineering, District 3 / District 4 Traffic Operations, or Resident Construction Engineer (RCE) personnel and the South Carolina Department of Public Safety (SCDPS) regarding law enforcement officer availability, roster integration, or division eligibility (including South Carolina Highway Patrol and State Transport Police) for the SCDOT work-zone secondary detail portal (dot.workoffduty.com / Extra Duty Solutions, Contract 4400031394).
  
​2. Canceled, Unfilled, or Delayed Work-Zone Details: All Daily Work Reports (DWRs), Resident Construction Engineer (RCE) logs, shift coverage logs, and contractor cancellation or delay notifications for active state and interstate highway projects (including the I-26 and I-85 corridors) in Greenville, Laurens, and Newberry Counties from June 1, 2026, to the present that document canceled, postponed, or unstaffed lane closures resulting from the unavailability of secondary law enforcement details.
  
​3. Portal Operational Guidelines: Any internal SCDOT Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), district instructions, or operational guidance distributed to RCE offices or prime contractors regarding the scheduling, cancellation, or county sheriff backfilling of work-zone law enforcement details through Extra Duty Solutions.

​Note: Pursuant to your office's prior guidance in FOIA #F26-14206, master procurement and solicitation files (Solicitation 5400023874 / Contract 4400031394) are being requested separately from the State Fiscal Accountability Authority (SFAA).

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Edwin Chadwick
